name: Wizard (2024)
description: Wizards are defined by their exhaustive study of magic’s inner workings, casting spells of explosive fire, arcing lightning, subtle deception, and spectacular transformations.
starting_equipment_options: (A) 2 Daggers, Arcane Focus (Quarterstaff), Robe, Spellbook, Scholar’s Pack, and 5 GP

1.name: Spellcasting
1.description: Access to Wizard spell list, prepare spells from spellbook. Starts with 3 cantrips, 4 prepared spells (from 6 in spellbook).

1.name: Ritual Adept
1.description: Can cast any spell as a Ritual if it has the Ritual tag and is in your spellbook (need not be prepared).

1.name: Arcane Recovery
1.description: Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots. Combined level up to half Wizard level (rounded up), none level 6+.

2.name: Scholar
2.description: Choose one proficient skill (Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion) to gain Expertise in.

3.name: Wizard Subclass
3.description: Gain a Wizard subclass. (Evoker is detailed in Basic Rules).

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.description: Gain Ability Score Improvement feat or other feat. Learns 1 additional cantrip.

5.name: Memorize Spell
5.description: After a Short Rest, study spellbook and replace one prepared L1+ Wizard spell with another from the book.

18.name: Spell Mastery
18.description: Choose a L1 and L2 spell from spellbook (action casting time). Always have them prepared, cast at lowest level without slot. Can change on Long Rest.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of Spell Recall recommended).

20.name: Signature Spells
20.description: Choose two L3 spells from spellbook. Always prepared, cast each once at L3 without slot per Short/Long Rest.
